episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: London, 2011: Massimo Ruggero, Head of Trading of the NYL Bank, makes the bank earn millions by speculating on the Greek crisis, but his past hinders his hope for a promotion.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Feeling betrayed and abandoned by Dominic, Massimo prepares incriminating documents to start a scandal against the NYL and earn money.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: With the help of the Argentine hacker Sofia, Massimo wants to find out if Dominic is trying to hide secret affairs with Gaddafi.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Massimo's team disobeys his orders by speculating on the Irish crisis, thus falling into the trap planned by Dominic. Meanwhile, detective Vicky has found a secret file.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: To find his missing wife, Dominic asks Massimo for help, to whom he confides he knows everything about the secret that binds him to Nina.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Massimo makes a pact with Vicky to obtain the secret file in exchange for the capture of Duval, but he is forced to send the plan upstream.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Massimo finally discovers the contents of the secret file: it is burning information on a plan developed by Dominic. And now Massimo fears for his life.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Massimo rushes with Sofia to Cetara to the bedside of his sick father, where he solves personal questions related to the past. In the meantime, Dominic is developing a strategy to stem Duval.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: To stop Dominic and provide the media with evidence of the scam, Massimo hacks NYL servers with the help of Subterranea, but has to deal with Duval.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Massimo can finally stop Dominic and discover the identity of the assassin, but his choices risk ruining the relationship with Sofia, who still has a card to play.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Dominic Morgan warns Massimo Ruggero that a new geo-political data war between China and the West has begun.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Massimo and his team vow to discover the truth about Brexit's tragic aftermath, and Dominic tries to convince Massimo that the Chinese are behind it.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Massimo's suspicions over Wu Zhi and Liwei grow, Oliver discovers that his chance of a future outside NYL has been sabotaged.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The battle lines are drawn between NYL and Dominic's new company - with former colleagues and friends pitted against one another.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: An accident outside a private Mayfair bank creates a once in a lifetime opportunity to discover the creator of Bitcoin.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Now knowing that he is a target, Massimo tires to retrieve the stolen evidence against him and creates a new plan to protect Europe and its citizens.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: In the final battle of the data war, Massimo has to finalise a new 5G deal with the EU and face the true threat to democracy.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: After years in exile, Massimo sees the opportunity presented by the COVID-19 pandemic to finally get justice.
